resource: Enter, leave and update entries in one visibility delta
allocation_impact: A larger change is sent as a full snapshot (resync); a delta never exceeds 256 entries.
boundary_tests: max=256: a change of exactly 256 entries is a delta
max+1=257: a change of 257 entries becomes a resync snapshot
notes: Re-decided in D87. Decision section 4.4; #162 comment 5875958040. Wire consumer: VIS-2 WORLD_SPATIAL type 2 (capability 6).
